name: Donquixote Doflamingo
title: Constrict your opponent with powerful Counters and Blockers!
desc: This deck harnesses a large number of Counter Events to take full advantage of Leader Doflamingo's effect. It is more adept than other decks at handling attacks by powerful Characters, wielding enough defensive strength to shrug off attacks that would normally be near fatal. While it's more vulnerable to barrages of small attacks, the abundance of green medium-sized Blockers helps deal with that. Fight slow and steady, with a solid defense as your backbone.
